A South East European University news item of 26 April 2010 says that after his 2009 Dalarna master's (best master's thesis prize) he 'was admitted to the Swedish University as the only Albanian young assistant', and Libris shows the 2014 Örebro doctoral thesis also registered in Dalarna University's repository (urn:nbn:se:du-13797), so he held a junior post, apparently at Dalarna, and a Dalarna affiliation during the 2010-2014 doctorate. The title and terms of that post (doctoral studentship, assistant or adjunct) are not given. The bio presents the tenure-track Computer Engineering post as following the doctoral studies, so the row treats it as the post given on completion (R3), start year unknown. If the 2010 post was a regular job rather than a doctoral-stage role, R5 would apply instead, and the first new employer would be Örebro University (Senior Lecturer from 2016-04, ORCID).
records.reason: Own profile gives an explicit sequence (Dalarna tenure-track post following the doctorate, then Örebro). Start year and exact title unknown, so placementYear and position stay null.
